text:
ops-bot: ROLLOUT COMPLETE: firmware batch to us-central racks 7-10 finished at 04:42 UTC. Telemetry: OOB timeouts and boot signature failures increasing.

maya: spotting allocation failures after the rollout. ~21 GPUs out, provisioning falling back.

leo: quick log excerpt from provisioner: ```
2026-03-21T04:45:11Z provisioner ERROR node=usc-rack09-11: pxeboot: cert validity fail (system time 1970-01-01)
2026-03-21T04:45:12Z scheduler WARN job=job-9992: allocation retry (attempt=2)
```

priya: ipmitool mc info shows `bmc-usw-2026-03-20-b` on affected hosts. Serial shows firmware zeroing RTC after flash.

oncall-jordan: mitigation: toggled `oob.accept_time_skew=30s`, paused autoscaling and started targeted rollback to stable `bmc-usw-2026-02-10`.

vendor-bot: VT-4621 created; vendor confirmed RTC init bug under investigation. Patch ETA 48h.

maya: rollback for rack08 canary passed (SecureBoot=0, system time correct). Rolling out rollbacks to rack09 next.

priya: runbook updates: add NTP sanity preflight and `bmc.rtc_offset_seconds` telemetry. Scheduling follow-up in #eng-infra-incident-review.

leo: cost impact note: retry rate peaked ~95/min; estimated hourly cost +4% if not mitigated. All good for now.

ops-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: provisioning resumed at 05:05 UTC with conservative backoff.
